query: UPDATE jobs SET status = '?', result = CAST($1 AS jsonb), completed_at = clock_timestamp(), active_attempt_id = NULL WHERE id = $2 AND status = '?' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM job_attempts a WHERE a.id = jobs.active_attempt_id AND a.status = '?' AND a.lease_until > clock_timestamp() AND a.deadline_at > clock_timestamp())
UPDATE jobs SET status='?',active_attempt_id=$1,attempt_count=attempt_count+1, deadline_at=$2,retry_at=NULL WHERE id=$3

WITH timing AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at), deadline AS (SELECT at, COALESCE(CAST($1 AS timestamptz), at + make_interval(secs => $2)) AS until FROM timing) INSERT INTO job_attempts(id,job_id,attempt_number,generation,claim_token,worker_id,status, started_at,heartbeat_at,lease_until,deadline_at,queue_delay_seconds) SELECT $3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,'?',at,at, LEAST(at + make_interval(secs => $9),until),until, CASE WHEN j.eligible_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (at-j.eligible_at))) END FROM deadline CROSS JOIN jobs j WHERE j.id=$10 RETURNING *
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO job_events (job_id, event_type, status, related_job_id, attempt_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)

SELECT j.id FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN job_attempts a ON a.id=j.active_attempt_id WHERE (j.status='?' AND (a.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR a.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())) OR (j.status='?' AND j.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY j.deadline_at,j.id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
INSERT INTO job_metric_counts(event,job_type,stripe,value) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT(event,job_type,stripe) DO UPDATE SET value=job_metric_counts.value+EXCLUDED.value
UPDATE job_attempts SET status=$1,error=$2,finished_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=$3 AND status='?'
SELECT json_build_object($1,count(*),$2,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ($3,$4,$5))) FROM jobs WHERE owner_id=$6

INSERT INTO job_metric_timings(kind,job_type,outcome,stripe,sample_count,total_seconds) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT(kind,job_type,outcome,stripe) DO UPDATE SET sample_count=job_metric_timings.sample_count+EXCLUDED.sample_count, total_seconds=job_metric_timings.total_seconds+EXCLUDED.total_seconds
SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE id = $1

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE retry_at>clock_timestamp()) AS waiting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE retry_at<=clock_timestamp()) AS due, coalesce(max(greatest($1,extract($2 FROM (clock_timestamp()- coalesce(eligible_at,greatest(created_at,scheduled_at,retry_at)))))),$3) AS oldest FROM jobs WHERE status=$4
SELECT type FROM jobs WHERE id=$1
SELECT job_id, priority, generation FROM job_outbox WHERE available_at <= now() ORDER BY priority DESC, available_at, created_at, job_id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM job_attempts WHERE id=$1 AND claim_token=$2 AND status='?'
SELECT GREATEST(coalesce(scheduled_at,created_at),retry_at)<=clock_timestamp() FROM jobs WHERE id=$1
SELECT type,status,count(*) AS count FROM jobs GROUP BY type,status
SELECT status,greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (finished_at-started_at))) AS seconds FROM job_attempts WHERE id=$1 AND finished_at IS NOT NULL

WITH timing AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS at) SELECT lease_until > at AS lease_live, deadline_at > at AS deadline_live, greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (lease_until-at))*1000)::bigint AS lease_ms, greatest(0,extract(epoch FROM (deadline_at-at))*1000)::bigint AS deadline_ms FROM job_attempts,timing WHERE id=$1
SELECT queue_delay_seconds FROM job_attempts WHERE id=$1 AND queue_delay_seconds IS NOT NULL
SELECT deadline_at<=clock_timestamp() FROM jobs WHERE id=$1
SELECT event,job_type,sum(value) AS value FROM job_metric_counts GROUP BY event,job_type
SELECT count(*) FROM jobs j JOIN job_attempts a ON a.id=j.active_attempt_id WHERE j.status=$1 AND a.lease_until<=clock_timestamp()

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at<=clock_timestamp()) AS due, count(*) FILTER (WHERE available_at>clock_timestamp()) AS scheduled, coalesce(max(greatest($1,extract($2 FROM (clock_timestamp()-available_at)))) FILTER (WHERE available_at<=clock_timestamp()),$3) AS oldest FROM job_outbox
SELECT kind,job_type,outcome,sum(sample_count) AS sample_count,sum(total_seconds) AS total_seconds FROM job_metric_timings GROUP BY kind,job_type,outcome
SELECT state,count(*) AS count FROM dead_letters GROUP BY state
